mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns during FEDFUNDS decline periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading above 200.0 indicates accelerating inflation, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 200.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in FEDFUNDS and increases in UNRATE signal an impending recession, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in economic contraction.
failure_condition: The interaction effect (FEDFUNDS decline and UNRATE increase) does not produce negative returns in > 60% of cases over 20-day horizon, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment falls below 4.5% and monthly job growth exceeds 0.5%, the labor market tightens, increasing inflation risks and prompting aggressive monetary tightening, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand and economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: HOUST growth does not correlate with positive 5d SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks mount.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) above 350,000 indicate robust consumer spending, which increases inflation expectations and triggers Fed rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when RSAFS > 350000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent strength in housing starts (HOUST) reflects sustained demand growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy expands without immediate inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: HOUST growth does not correlate with positive 60d SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.
